seoTitle: Manchester River Cruises | Boat Tours, Events & Ferry from Salford Quays
seoDescription: Sightseeing river cruises, live music and party nights, and matchday ferries on the Manchester Ship Canal from Salford Quays. Book direct with Manchester River Cruises.
heading: See Manchester from the Water
intro: Sightseeing cruises, live music nights and matchday ferries from Salford Quays

sections.heading: The City River Tour
body: Our signature sightseeing cruise glides along the historic Manchester Ship Canal from Salford Quays, with live commentary bringing the waterfront's landmarks and stories to life.

sections.heading: Find your date
body: Tell us when you're free — see everything sailing that day.

sections.heading: Matchday by boat
body: Skip the matchday traffic and arrive at Old Trafford by ferry along the Ship Canal.

sections.heading: Make it yours
body: Charter a boat exclusively for your celebration, corporate event or private party.

cards.name: Music Cruises
cards.desc: Live tribute and themed nights — ABBA, Elvis, Dolly, Adele, Soul and more.

cards.name: Party Nights
cards.desc: Boat parties on the Ship Canal — dancing, drinks and the city skyline.

cards.name: Christmas on the water
cards.desc: Festive party nights and seasonal cruises through the winter.
